_note: Phase 9b predictive-chapter scaffold for year_ahead. Key path: chapter_kind -> domain_key -> block string (matches selectors/block_selector.py's select_block(report_type, 'predictive_chapters', chapter_kind, domain_key) once generate.py is wired to call it). ~65 words each. Must keep the Phase 9b hedged/research framing ("the system flags", "research signal", not a settled claim) -- this is the one section of the product that is NOT supposed to read as a confident established claim, per the 2026-07-08 operator decision in EO_UPGRADE_PHASES_1_9_AGENT_PROMPTS.md Phase 9b. fallback: The system flags this as a possible predictive chapter, not a settled claim about what must happen. Treat it as a research signal pointing toward one area where timing, attention, and lived evidence may begin to cluster. You do not have to force meaning from it. Notice where the same question returns, then let real circumstances show whether the pattern has weight.

profection_year.fallback: The system flags this as an annual emphasis, a place where the year may ask for more conscious participation. This is not a promise of dramatic events. It is a research signal that one practical arena may become easier to track, because choices, responsibilities, and repeated experiences keep pointing back there. Let the year teach you through recurrence, not pressure.
profection_year.identity: The system flags your identity, presence, and self-definition as a possible annual focus. This research signal does not claim you must reinvent yourself. It suggests the year may keep returning you to questions of how you enter rooms, claim space, and recognize your own authority. Watch what strengthens when you stop performing an outdated version of yourself for familiarity.
profection_year.resources: The system flags money, energy, possessions, and self-worth as a possible annual focus. This research signal may show up through budgets, earning patterns, pricing, appetite, or what you can no longer spend yourself on. The point is not austerity by default. It is learning which forms of security actually support you, and which only keep an old fear comfortable.
profection_year.communication: The system flags communication, learning, and your immediate environment as a possible annual focus. This research signal may gather around conversations, writing, study, logistics, siblings, neighbors, or the agreements that organize daily life. Notice what becomes easier when you name things plainly. The year may not require louder speech, but more accurate translation between thought, context, and response.
profection_year.home: The system flags home, family, ancestry, and private foundations as a possible annual focus. This research signal may appear through your living space, household roles, inherited patterns, or the quiet conditions needed for rest. It does not assume disruption. It asks you to observe what kind of shelter actually restores you, and what private arrangement has outgrown its usefulness.
profection_year.creativity: The system flags creativity, pleasure, romance, and play as a possible annual focus. This research signal may not arrive as effortless inspiration. profection_year.work: The system flags work, routines, service, and body maintenance as a possible annual focus. This research signal may show up through schedule changes, skill-building, health rhythms, or the difference between usefulness and depletion. It does not say productivity is the lesson. profection_year.partnership: The system flags partnership, collaboration, and one-to-one agreements as a possible annual focus. This research signal may gather through intimacy, clients, conflict, allies, or the contracts you make with other people. The emphasis is not simply on finding or fixing relationships. profection_year.transformation: The system flags shared stakes, intimacy, grief, debt, and deep change as a possible annual focus. This research signal may appear where trust, vulnerability, or entanglement requires more honesty than surface harmony can provide. It does not predict loss. It suggests that the year may clarify what must be metabolized, renegotiated, or returned to its rightful owner.
profection_year.meaning: The system flags belief, study, travel, teaching, and worldview as a possible annual focus. This research signal may show up as a widened horizon, a question of faith, or a need to test inherited assumptions against lived experience. It does not demand certainty. profection_year.vocation: The system flags vocation, visibility, reputation, and public contribution as a possible annual focus. profection_year.community: The system flags friendship, networks, audience, and collective belonging as a possible annual focus. profection_year.spirit: The system flags solitude, surrender, hidden patterns, and inner repair as a possible annual focus. return_year.identity: The system flags identity as a return-year research signal. return_year.resources: The system flags resources as a return-year research signal. Old patterns around money, value, safety, possession, or self-trust may return with new context. return_year.communication: The system flags communication as a return-year research signal. return_year.home: The system flags home as a return-year research signal. Family themes, living arrangements, memory, ancestry, or the definition of safety may circle back for review. return_year.creativity: The system flags creativity and pleasure as a return-year research signal. return_year.partnership: The system flags partnership as a return-year research signal. return_year.community: The system flags community as a return-year research signal. Former friendships, audiences, groups, or shared dreams may resurface, perhaps through reconnection or contrast.
